run_NLI_classifier: run the NLI classifier to train and evaluate a multilingual natural language inference model on sentence embeddings
run_NLI_cross_lingual: run the NLI classifier in cross-lingual mode to evaluate accuracy across multiple language pairs
create_LoadDataNLI: create a PyTorch DataLoader from premise and hypothesis embedding files with labels for NLI training
create_Net_MLP: create a multi-layer perceptron network for NLI classification with configurable hidden layers and activation functions
test_Net_TestCorpus: test the trained NLI network on a development or test corpus and print per-class accuracy
